voice_remixing_prompts.prompt: Remix this voice into a highly natural English-speaking professional sales consultant. Preserve the speaker identity, but make the delivery less robotic, less scripted, and less evenly paced. The voice should sound clean, close, full-band, and studio-quality, not phone-filtered, muffled, compressed, distant, or low-bandwidth. Add natural human rhythm: some phrases should move a little faster when the speaker is confident or explaining something useful, while empathy phrases and important points should slow down briefly. Avoid one fixed speed across the whole sentence. Add subtle pitch movement and emotional responsiveness, especially in openings and objection handling. The speaker should occasionally sound like they are thinking live, with tiny conversational texture, but never like an actor exaggerating. Combine effects naturally: a short filler such as 'so' or 'okay' can carry a slight upward pitch and be followed by a short pause; a reassuring phrase can soften in tone and then continue with firmer confidence; an important keyword can receive slight emphasis and then return to faster sales pacing. Keep the tone warm, calm, confident, trustworthy, and professional. Do not make it seductive, theatrical, announcer-like, radio-ad-like, influencer-like, tired, elderly, aggressive, pushy, or overly cheerful. Do not make the voice slower. The final voice should feel like a trained human sales consultant speaking live in a real conversation, not reading a script at a constant rhythm.
voice_remixing_prompts.custom_script: Hi there, thanks for taking the call. My name is Mara, and I will keep this quick. [short pause] So, before I explain anything, I just want to check whether this is actually relevant for you. If it is not, no problem. But if it is, I can walk you through the useful part in plain language. [thoughtful pause] I understand the concern about cost; the important thing is that we do not push anything that does not fit. What I can do is ask one or two quick questions, and then we will know whether it makes sense to continue.
success_criteria: opening does not trigger an immediate robot-detection reaction
voice is faster than normal but still clear
filler-like microtexture sounds bundled with pitch or pause instead of pasted in
audio quality is clean and not phone-filtered

voice_design_profiles.voice_design_prompt: Native English professional call-center sales agent. Warm, present, emotionally responsive, and confident without sounding pushy. Clean full-band studio-quality voice, not telephone-filtered, muffled, compressed, distant, or low-bandwidth. Sounds like a real trained sales consultant in a live conversation, not a narrator, announcer, podcast host, or customer-support bot. Natural pitch movement, faster-than-normal sales-call pace, relaxed but precise articulation, light conversational texture, and believable thinking pauses. Handles objections with calm confidence and empathy. Avoid robotic flatness, theatrical excitement, exaggerated friendliness, fear pressure, overacting, and a slow scripted reading style.

dashboard_steps: Create or select voice candidates for profiles: elevenlabs-sales-agent-en-v1, elevenlabs-sales-agent-de-v1.
Use synthetic preview text only; do not upload private call audio or customer voices.
Try Voice Design UI candidates first: clean-natural-medium-guidance, creative-less-robotic, prompt-faithful-clean-sales.
Remix selected voices with prompts: elevenlabs-remix-en-sales-naturalizer-v1, elevenlabs-remix-de-sales-naturalizer-v1.
Test voice settings candidates: realtime-balanced, emotional-opening, clarity-safe, expressive-quality.
Listen first to openings, then objection handling, then protected-text clarity.
Keep human ratings separate from provider latency and response-content quality.
Promote a voice only after English and German samples both pass the listening rubric.
